subject: can this problem be solved with ggplot?

messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: can this problem be solved with ggplot?
parts:
Hi,

 

I’m having an issue whenever I paste plots into Word and then save as PDF. If I have dashed lines, the legend does crazy things (once it’s in PDF). Anyway to fix this on the ggplot side?

 

ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Width, Sepal.Length, linetype = Species)) + geom_smooth(se=F)

 

…then I paste the plot into Word. Then I save document as PDF, and this is the result (happens to all plots having dashed lines in the legend):

 

Adam Loveland

Model Development

Balance Sheet Analytics and Modeling

messages.author: 2a56486f3e6fef84
messages.subject: Re: can this problem be solved with ggplot?
parts:
Hi Adam.

Have you already tried first saving the plot as an image file, and then importing the image file into your Word document? Use the ggsave() function to save the plot first, then instead of pasting, choose 'insert image' (or some similar-sounding option) in Word.

Luke
